notes: Sourced from Teradek's official Vidiu X Reference Guide (v1, 2021), a PDF hosted on Teradek's CDN and linked from the archived product page at teradek.com/pages/vidiu-x (product is now discontinued). Physical Properties diagram (p.4) and Technical Specifications tables (p.20-21) were used directly. Not modeled: SD card slot (full-size SD/SDXC, storage only — not a signal/power connector in this taxonomy) and internal Wi-Fi 6 antennas (no external RF connector). HDMI version/grade omitted because Teradek does not publish an HDMI spec revision (1.4/2.0) for the In/Out ports — supported resolutions top out at 1080p60/720p60, well within HDMI 1.4 bandwidth, but this is inferred, not stated, so grade was left unset per instructions. The Mic/Line input's physical connector is a 3.5mm stereo mini-jack based on the reference guide's icon and standard camera-encoder convention; the manual does not spell out "3.5mm" in text. Power is delivered exclusively via USB-C (no captive AC cord or IEC inlet), consistent with "Powered USB-C host port" in the manual's Power table.

ports.name: HDMI In
ports.note: 1x HDMI Type A receptacle; embedded 2-channel audio. HDMI version not stated by manufacturer (max output 1080p60), so no grade set.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: 1x HDMI Type A receptacle (loop-through of input source). HDMI version not stated by manufacturer, so no grade set.

ports.name: Mic/Line In
ports.note: Labeled 'Mic/Line stereo input' in manual; 2-channel analog audio input, switchable mic/line level.

ports.name: USB Modem Port
ports.note: Powered USB 2.0 Type-A host port for 3G/4G/5G USB cellular modems; also used for USB storage recording.

ports.name: USB-C Power Input
ports.note: Sole power input for the device ('Powered USB-C host port'); nominal 7W, max 12W. No AC inlet or DC barrel on the unit; powered via included USB-C PD-style adapter.
